title: Markdown Release Notes
prompt: We're rolling 2.4.0. Check CHANGELOG.md and docs/migration.md for the required CLI migration flag, then report only that flag string.

CHANGELOG.md: - BREAKING: auth middleware defaults to v2. See docs/migration.md.
docs/migration.md: For version 2.4.0, set --enable-v2-auth during rollout. Do not use --legacy-auth for 2.4.0.
